raw_record.question_text: In the figure, $m\angle 1 = 50$ and $m\angle 3 = 60$. Find the measure of $\angle 5$.

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as two parallel horizontal lines labeled p and q, with the slanted line m crossing both. Angle 5 is at the intersection of m with the upper horizontal line p, and angle 3 is at the intersection of m with the lower horizontal line q. From the text, m∠3 = 60. Since p ∥ q and m is a transversal, ∠5 and ∠3 are congruent as corresponding/alternate exterior acute angles in the displayed positions. Therefore m∠5 = 60.

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as containing a central triangle formed by the slanted lines k and m and the upper horizontal line p. Also read the markings showing p ∥ q and j ∥ k. From the text, m∠1 = 50 and m∠3 = 60. Transfer ∠1 to the left base angle of the central triangle, ∠4, using the parallel relationships j ∥ k and p ∥ q, so ∠4 = 50. Through the intersection of k and m, imagine a line parallel to p and q; the angle that m makes with this auxiliary parallel is equal to ∠3, namely 60. Thus the apex angle of the central triangle is 180 − 50 − 60 = 70. Finally use the triangle angle sum in the central triangle: ∠5 = 180 − ∠4 − apex = 180 − 50 − 70 = 60.

It also shows two rising slanted lines labeled j and k with matching parallel markings, so j ∥ k. The slanted line k, the slanted line m, and the upper horizontal line p form a central triangle. Angle 4 is the left base angle of this triangle, angle 5 is the right base angle, and the apex is where k and m meet above p. Angle 1 is shown where j meets the lower horizontal line q, and angle 3 is shown where m meets q.

Reasoning: Given m∠1 = 50 and m∠3 = 60. Since j ∥ k and p ∥ q, angle 1 corresponds to the left base angle of the central triangle, so ∠4 = 50. Now imagine a line through the intersection of k and m that is parallel to p and q. The angle that m makes with this auxiliary parallel equals ∠3, so it is 60. The angle that k makes with this auxiliary parallel matches ∠4, so it is 50. Therefore the apex angle between k and m is 180 − 50 − 60 = 70. In the central triangle, the angles are ∠4, the apex angle, and ∠5, so ∠5 = 180 − 50 − 70 = 60.
